description: public.rtf from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened file:///private/tmp/rclip-capture/page.html (h1, a paragraph with bold/italic and a link, a 3-row bordered table), used the Find bar to move focus into the page, then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: Safari converts the selection to RTF itself rather than going through the HTML: the link becomes {\field{\*\fldinst{HYPERLINK "https://example.org/target"}}{\fldrslt ...}} and the table becomes three \trowd rows. Three times the size of the HTML for the same selection.
